item.name: Register Device
item.description: Requires existing employee with matching name. Fields: name, employeeId, deviceId. Optional: deviceName/platform/model/osVersion/appVersion.

item.name: Send OTP
item.description: Send device OTP. Body: userId (user _id or employeeId/_id), employeeId (optional), deviceId or deviceName. Requires OTP email to be configured (superadmin).

item.name: Verify OTP
item.description: Verify OTP. Header: x-device-id (deviceId) or deviceId in body. Body: otpTransactionId, otp.

item.name: Set OTP Email (superadmin)
item.description: Superadmin only. Configures global OTP destination email. Requires Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}} for superadmin.

item.name: Get OTP Email (superadmin)
item.description: Superadmin only. Fetch global OTP destination email. Requires Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}} for superadmin.

item.name: Add Employee
item.description: Create employee and linked user. No password required/stored. Auth required (Bearer).
